title: At the wheel
logline: Last Bell from inside the Legacy at the curb across the road: the back of a head, the windshield, the school through it, the bell shape drawn in the glass's reflection. The pup's chin on the seat back.

panels.composition: From the back seat of a station wagon: the back of a graying head at the wheel, the windshield, and through it a high school at the last bell with students pouring out, a faint jagged bell shape reflected in the glass. A small dog's chin on the seat back.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, from the back seat of an old station wagon, the back of a graying man's head at the wheel and through the windshield a high school at the last bell with students pouring out, a faint jagged sound shape reflected in the glass, a small three-legged dog's chin resting on the seat back, no words
